support.howIntroduction: Manage shared meals, expenses and monthly accounts from one reliable workspace.
support.howCreateBody: A manager creates the workspace. Members join it and use the same live records.
support.howRecordBody: Add meals, bazar expenses, utilities and deposits manually or through Quick Add with AI.
support.howReviewBody: Preview every AI-generated entry, correct the details, then confirm it. Nothing is saved before confirmation.
support.howCloseBody: Messzen combines meals, costs and deposits so members can review their monthly bill and balance.
support.contactIntroduction: Tell us what happened and include the affected month or feature so the team can help quickly.
support.accountAccessBody: Get help with sign-in, profile details, mess membership or manager access.
support.mealsBillingBody: Report a mismatch in meals, expenses, deposits, utilities or monthly calculations.
support.aiQuickAddBody: Share the transcript and expected result when voice transcription or command analysis needs attention.
support.privacyIntroduction: This summary explains what Messzen uses to operate your mess workspace and keep its records available to authorized members.
support.informationUseAccount: Account and contact details you provide
support.informationUseRecords: Mess membership, meals, expenses and payment records
support.informationUseTechnical: Technical information needed for security and reliable operation
support.whyUseBody: We use the information to provide app features, calculate shared accounts, protect access, resolve support requests and improve reliability.
support.recordVisibilityBody: Workspace records are available only according to each member or manager role. We do not sell personal information.
support.choicesBody: You may update account information from Profile and contact support for privacy questions or account-data requests.
support.policyUpdatesBody: If this policy changes materially, the updated version and effective date will be made available in the app.
support.termsIntroduction: These terms explain the responsibilities that help keep Messzen and every shared mess workspace accurate, secure and dependable.
support.acceptingBody: By creating an account or using Messzen, you agree to follow these terms and the policies made available inside the app.
support.accountAccurate: Provide accurate account information and keep it updated
support.accountCredentials: Keep your password and access credentials confidential
support.accountNotify: Notify support if you believe your account has been used without permission
support.workspaceResponsibilitiesBody: Members and managers are responsible for reviewing meals, expenses, deposits, utilities and billing entries before confirming or relying on them.
support.acceptableUseSecurity: Do not misuse the service, interfere with its operation or attempt unauthorized access
support.acceptableUseContent: Do not submit unlawful, misleading or harmful information
support.acceptableUsePrivacy: Respect the privacy and access rights of other workspace members
support.subscriptionAvailabilityBody: Plan features, pricing and service availability may change. Current subscription details shown in the app apply to the connected mess workspace.
support.changesSupportBody: We may update these terms as Messzen evolves. Material updates will be made available in the app. Contact support if you have questions about these terms.
